attempts.summary: Configured node1 as an NFSv4 server exporting /srv/nfs/shared to node2 and node3 over the shared storage network (10.100.102.0/24), using a shared sharedops user/group (UID/GID 4200) on all three nodes and mode 2770 on the export. Both clients mounted the export at /mnt/shared via NFSv4.2 (persisted in /etc/fstab with _netdev). Verified bidirectional, immediate cross-client file visibility with correct sharedops:sharedops ownership/permission preservation. Completed the mandatory sequential restart protocol for all three nodes, proving boot-identity change and post-restart recovery of NFS service, exports, mounts, and data for each.
